effect_description_eng: ＜Reboot＞ ＜Blocker＞ [All Turns] When any of your Digimon would leave the battle area, by suspending this Digimon, they don't leave. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon suspends, you may delete all of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon. Then, by trashing 1 [Craniamon] or [X Antibody] from this Digimon's digivolution cards, activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side.

option.effect_text: [Main] Until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of your Digimon with ＜Blocker＞ isn't affected by their Digimon effects and gets +5000 DP. Then, 1 of your Digimon may unsuspend.
